caption: A tennis ball rolls off the end of a table and curves down to the floor, landing a short distance out from the table's edge, and bounces on.

sa.check: A tennis ball rolls off the end of a table.
It curves down to the floor.
It lands a short distance out from the edge.
The roll off comes first, then the curve down, then the bounce.

pc.expect: It keeps moving forward as it leaves the edge and lands beyond it, not straight below.
pc.fail: It drops straight down at the edge; or stops in the air; or reverses.

pc.expect: The curve steepens as it falls and it falls faster.
pc.fail: It flies flat; or hangs; or slows.

pc.expect: It bounces lower than it dropped.
pc.fail: It bounces higher; or the same height; or stops dead.

pc.expect: It squashes briefly and springs back round.
pc.fail: It stays flat; or sinks into the floor; or splashes.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the table changes; or the room rearranges.
